snippet.title: ♾️ Infinity Nikki Version 2.11 Trailer | Tales Woven in Time
snippet.description:
♾️ Infinity Nikki Version 2.11 Trailer | Tales Woven in Time

Snowflakes drift down, and twinkling lights wake the winter night's dream.
Wishes stir within the pages, and fairy tales of old are softly unsealed.
Follow the clues left behind...
A story that never ended unfolds once more.
What did the warriors lose along the way, and what legends were left for the ages?

Infinity Nikki Version 2.11 "Tales Woven in Time" launches on October 29 (UTC-7)!
The exclusive quest "The Snow Remembers" opens, and fun event gameplay updates arrive, including "Mira Building Open Day", "Touring Sleigh," "Adventure Among Stars", and reward events. More adventures and surprises await. See you there, stylists!

——
➤ Infinity Nikki Version 2.11 Tales Woven in Time launches globally on October 29 (UTC-7)!
